records.source: Reuters, 19 Oct 2026 — China's Q3 GDP details
records.claim: China released third-quarter growth of 4.5% year on year on Monday, October 19, above a 4.4% Reuters consensus and up from 4.3% in the preceding quarter. Industrial output rose 5.5% year on year in September, while retail sales increased only 1.1%; property investment remains weak. This is a new measurement of an ongoing structural divergence: exports and manufacturing bear much of the growth burden while domestic consumption remains soft. The figures do not in themselves establish a new trade restriction.
